title: Montevideo Convention
summary: Wikidata item Q210862, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty for the purposes of good state and diplomatic coexistence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 11 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1357116287, argues the convention out of the Seventh International Conference of American States and the Good Neighbor Policy declared there, and forward into the declarative theory of statehood; this atlas holds neither the conference nor the policy, and the article does not relate the convention to any declaration of independence this corpus now holds. A criterion of statehood is not an event that decided one.
